stories.headline: Anthropic Embeds D&B, Verisk, Experian and Moody's as Native Data Connectors in Claude for Financial Services
stories.summary: Anthropic expanded its Claude for Financial Services platform in May 2026, adding D&B, Verisk, Experian, IBISWorld and others as native data connectors alongside an embedded Moody's full-platform app — enabling users to run credit and risk analysis on 600M+ companies without leaving the Claude interface. This is direct validation of D&B's 'be everywhere' neutrality strategy: D&B data is now a live ingredient inside a leading agentic AI workflow at JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Citi and others. The competitive risk is that Moody's scored the marquee 'native app' slot while D&B sits in the connector tier — a positioning gap worth watching.

stories.headline: 96% of B2B Marketers Use AI But Only 44% Have Data Infrastructure Ready to Support It
stories.summary: A 2026 Demand Gen Report survey and Adobe's 2026 AI and Digital Trends Report — reported by CIO Dive and framed in an Adobe/AWS solution brief — found that despite near-universal AI adoption among B2B marketers, fewer than half rate their data quality and accessibility as adequate for AI workloads. The finding crystallises the exact problem D&B's entity resolution, DUNS, and 600M+ record foundation is built to solve: agents are only as good as the data underneath them. For D&B's sales narrative, this is a ready-made 'ground truth' proof point for every enterprise AI conversation.

stories.headline: Salesforce Agentforce Hits $800M ARR and 29,000 Deals — Agentic AI Spend Now a Budget Line, Not a Pilot
stories.summary: Gartner projects $201.9 billion in agentic AI enterprise spending in 2026 — up 141% year-over-year — with Salesforce Agentforce's $800M ARR and 2.4 billion 'agentic work units' processed serving as the clearest proof that agent products have moved from experiment to committed, renewable spend. The critical caveat: Gartner also warns that over 40% of agentic AI projects are at risk of cancellation by 2027 due to unproven ROI, and only one in five companies has a mature governance model. For D&B, the spend surge accelerates the urgency of embedding into Agentforce and peer platforms — but the governance gap is also a selling point for explainable, auditable data signals over black-box agent outputs.
stories.source: The Economy / Gartner via multiple outlets

stories.headline: Verisk Cuts Price Target as Barclays Downgrades — CHRO Also Departs in Leadership Shuffle
stories.summary: In the first week of September 2026, Barclays lowered its price target on Verisk Analytics from $275 to $225, and the company separately announced the retirement of its Chief Human Relations Officer. Coming after the Q2 guidance caution that already rattled investors, the price target cut signals growing Wall Street skepticism about Verisk's near-term growth trajectory. For D&B, a competitor under valuation pressure and leadership transition creates a potential window to compete more aggressively for insurance and financial risk contracts where the two firms overlap.
stories.tag: B2B Data Company News / Competitor Watch

stories.headline: Clari + Salesloft Integration Still Incomplete Nine Months After Merger — Buyers Left Navigating Four Overlapping Products
stories.summary: Nine months after Clari's December 2025 merger with Salesloft, buyers are still navigating four separate products — Copilot, Groove, Salesloft cadences, and Clari forecasting — with separate pricing and interfaces, and platform unification described internally as a 'multi-year effort.' Meanwhile, Gong and Clari both ship AI agents in 2026, but analysts note that most of the deal-scrub, CRM update, and forecast commentary work still sits with humans. The integration drag is a structural opening: revenue intelligence tools without clean, enriched account data underneath them cannot deliver on the 'fully agentic execution' promise — exactly the gap D&B's account intelligence and buying-signal data is positioned to fill.

stories.headline: Jane Street Signs $13B AI Cloud Contract With Crusoe — Trading Firm Now Holds More Committed Compute Than Most Model Labs
stories.summary: Quantitative trading firm Jane Street signed a five-year AI cloud contract with data center upstart Crusoe worth approximately $13 billion, providing GPU clusters and infrastructure for AI training and inference. The deal — Crusoe's largest and most prominent cloud customer to date — pushed Jane Street's total committed AI compute spend across Crusoe and CoreWeave to roughly $19 billion, more than most frontier model developers have ever contracted. It signals that sophisticated non-tech buyers are now treating raw compute as a core proprietary asset, not a utility.

stories.headline: Etched Raises $700M for Rack-Scale AI Inference Silicon — Custom Chip Bet Lands Its First Customer Delivery
stories.summary: Etched, a startup designing custom AI inference accelerators and full rack-scale systems, announced a $700 million funding round on 18 August 2026, with its first customer rack already delivered. The raise comes as inference-focused chip companies dominate AI hardware investment — eight of the twelve disclosed AI chip deals between January and August 2026 were inference-oriented, capturing roughly 67% of the $5.37 billion raised in that period. For D&B, this reinforces that the compute stack is bifurcating hard between training and inference layers, with inference economics now attracting the majority of capital.

stories.headline: European Defence Officials Openly Resist Brussels' Push to Cut Reliance on US Cloud and AI Giants
stories.summary: Senior European defence officials are pushing back against EU Commission efforts to reduce dependency on American cloud providers and AI platforms, exposing a deep rift between the bloc's digital sovereignty agenda and its operational security requirements. The dispute illustrates how geopolitical AI strategy is colliding with procurement reality — European defence bodies depend on US infrastructure that the Commission wants to replace. This tension is directly relevant to any data or AI vendor, like D&B, that operates across both US and EU enterprise accounts.

stories.headline: Texas TRAIGA Complaint Mechanism Goes Live in September 2026 — New AI Accountability Pressure Point for Enterprise Vendors
stories.summary: Texas's AI governance law TRAIGA (HB 149) activates its attorney general complaint mechanism this month, giving regulators a formal channel to pursue AI vendors for prohibited uses and disclosure failures. Texas joins Connecticut's CART Act and California's AI Transparency Act in creating enforceable, state-level AI accountability obligations that apply to enterprise software sold into those markets. For D&B's sales team, this matters because customer procurement teams are increasingly demanding auditable, explainable AI outputs — exactly the 'Explainability First' positioning D&B leads with.

stories.headline: Labour and Reform Dead-Level at 23% as UK Politics Fragments Further
stories.summary: The latest YouGov polling shows Labour and Reform UK neck-and-neck at 23% each, with the Green Party surging — particularly among under-35s where it commands 38% of the vote. The fragmentation follows Reform's strong showing in the May local elections, where it gained over 1,400 councillors. Pollster John Curtice says no party currently has significant public backing, making the next general election genuinely unpredictable.

stories.headline: Vessel Struck in Strait of Hormuz as Iran Conflict Enters New Phase
stories.summary: A vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday 13 September, the latest incident as the US-Iran conflict — now in its seventh month — continues to escalate. BRICS nations including China and Russia issued a joint statement urging restraint, while Iran destroyed a US advanced drone over Hormuz. Trump said on Saturday he expects the war to end 'very soon' and predicted oil prices will fall sharply when it does.

stories.headline: Physicists Directly Observe Einstein's Gravity in the Quantum World for the First Time
stories.summary: Scientists have directly observed a long-predicted quantum effect of gravity using ultracold atoms, putting one of Einstein's foundational ideas to a striking new experimental test. The breakthrough, published 8 September, bridges the gap between general relativity and quantum mechanics — one of the deepest unsolved problems in physics. Researchers say the result opens a new experimental window into quantum gravity.

stories.headline: Shane Lowry Wins Amgen Irish Open by Record 11-Shot Margin at Doonbeg
stories.summary: Shane Lowry claimed a dominant victory at the Amgen Irish Open on Sunday 13 September, winning by a record 11 shots over Joaquin Niemann and Patrick Reed at Trump International Golf Links in Doonbeg. It was his seventh DP World Tour title and his second Irish Open, coming 17 years after his first. Lowry took home $1.02 million of the $6 million purse and now looks firmly in contention in the Race to Dubai.

stories.headline: Nottingham Forest Beat Aston Villa 2-1 as Chelsea Held by Promoted Hull City
stories.summary: Nottingham Forest secured a 2-1 win over Aston Villa in the Premier League on 12 September, leaving Unai Emery's side still without a league win this season. Elsewhere, Chelsea were held to a 2-2 draw by newly promoted Hull City, and Tottenham and Everton played out a goalless stalemate. Ipswich Town edged Crystal Palace 3-2 in the pick of the weekend's action.

stories.headline: BMW PGA Championship at Wentworth Tees Off Thursday — Europe's Biggest Rolex Series Event
stories.summary: The BMW PGA Championship gets underway at Wentworth's West Course on Thursday 17 September, the DP World Tour's flagship Rolex Series event on home soil. The field will be boosted by Ryder Cup stars looking to make a statement ahead of the season run-in, and the Race to Dubai is finely poised following Lowry's Irish Open victory. It is one of only five Rolex Series events on the 2026 DP World Tour schedule.

stories.headline: Dark Energy Debunked? New Supernovae Analysis Suggests Universe May Not Be Accelerating
stories.summary: A major new analysis of more than 1,700 supernovae is challenging the established view that the universe's expansion is accelerating — the cornerstone assumption behind dark energy. Published on 8 September, the study raises the possibility that cosmic acceleration may be an illusion produced by how data has been interpreted. If confirmed, it would upend the standard model of cosmology and decades of Nobel Prize-winning work.

stories.headline: Stripe Acquires OpenRouter for $7B+: The Neutral Infrastructure Play That Reframes the AI Business Model
stories.summary: Stripe finalized a deal to acquire OpenRouter — a platform that routes token requests dynamically across 400+ AI models from 80+ providers based on cost, speed, and reliability — for more than $7 billion, a 5x-plus premium to its May 2026 Series B valuation. The strategic logic is that tokens are becoming the central currency of the AI economy, and whoever owns the routing and billing layer owns the economic infrastructure — a direct parallel to how Stripe won payments by being the trusted neutral layer between merchants and card networks. For D&B, this is the Visa analogy made literal: the winning AI infrastructure play is neutral aggregation, not vertical lock-in. D&B's own 'be everywhere' posture — embedding DUNS entity resolution and Paydex into every agentic platform rather than betting on one — mirrors exactly the architectural bet Stripe is making by acquiring OpenRouter. Critically, developers flagged neutrality as the first constraint within hours of the deal breaking, confirming that trust and model-agnosticism are now explicit competitive requirements in agentic infrastructure.
stories.source: Ben Thompson, Stratechery; additional reporting from TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Forbes, Yahoo Finance, Stripe Newsroom

stories.headline: Databricks 2026 State of AI Agents: Multi-Agent Systems Grew 327% in Four Months — and Governance Is Now the 12x Differentiator
stories.summary: Databricks' 2026 State of AI Agents report, drawing on data from more than 20,000 organizations including over 60% of the Fortune 500, finds that enterprises are rapidly transitioning from single chatbots to multi-agent systems, which grew 327% in under four months. The report's sharpest finding is on the governance gap: companies using AI governance frameworks get more than 12x as many AI projects into production, while those using evaluation tools get nearly 6x the production rate — meaning governance is not a compliance checkbox but the primary value-creation lever. For D&B, this directly validates the Explainability First / Ground Truth pillar: as agents proliferate and governance becomes the 12x multiplier, D&B's role as the verifiable, auditable data layer underpinning agent decisions becomes a hard competitive requirement rather than a nice-to-have. The data also reinforces D&B's Pipeline Risk and Account Intelligence agent archetypes — agents operating in multi-agent environments need trusted, resolved entity data to avoid compounding errors at scale.
stories.source: Databricks, 2026 State of AI Agents Report

stories.headline: Trusted Agentic AI Landscape Q3 2026: Lock-In Has Shifted from the Model Layer to the Stack Layer — and That Changes Everything
stories.summary: Independent enterprise AI architect Kai Waehner updated his Agentic AI vendor landscape for Q3 2026, adding a critical new finding: a US export-control episode that temporarily suspended access to certain frontier models has accelerated a structural shift — vendor lock-in is no longer primarily at the model layer but at the stack layer, meaning orchestration frameworks, data connectors, and agent infrastructure are where enterprises are now most exposed. The analysis maps every major vendor — Microsoft, Google, AWS, Anthropic, Salesforce, SAP, and others — on two axes: trust and flexibility, with the Q3 update showing that trust requirements have hardened significantly post the export-control shock. For D&B, this is a direct strategic signal: as lock-in migrates upward to the orchestration and data stack, D&B's neutral, platform-agnostic positioning across Copilot, Agentforce, Gemini, Bedrock, and ServiceNow becomes a structural moat rather than a distribution preference. The shift also underscores D&B's Entity Resolution as Foundation thesis — in a multi-stack world where agents span several platforms, consistent entity resolution is the only way to prevent the same company appearing as a different entity in each stack layer.
stories.source: Kai Waehner, kai-waehner.de, Trusted Agentic AI Landscape Q3 2026

data_science.topic: dbt (data build tool) — Transforming Raw Data into Reliable Analytics
data_science.tagline: SQL-first data transformation with software engineering best practices baked in — version control, testing, and documentation for every model.
data_science.what_it_is: dbt (data build tool) is an open-source transformation framework that lets data engineers and analysts write modular SQL SELECT statements — called 'models' — and then dbt handles compiling, running, testing, and documenting them in your data warehouse. It sits in the 'T' of ELT (Extract, Load, Transform), meaning raw data is loaded into the warehouse first, and dbt transforms it in place. It brings software engineering discipline — version control via Git, unit tests, CI/CD pipelines, and auto-generated data lineage documentation — to what was previously ad hoc SQL scripting. There are two editions: dbt Core (open-source CLI) and dbt Cloud (managed SaaS with a scheduler, IDE, and observability layer).
data_science.how_it_works:
1. MODELS: Each model is a single .sql file containing one SELECT statement. dbt materialises it as a table or view in your warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, etc.). Models reference each other with a {{ ref('model_name') }} macro, which lets dbt build a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of all dependencies automatically.

2. DAG EXECUTION: When you run 'dbt run', dbt resolves the DAG, compiles Jinja-templated SQL into plain SQL, and executes models in the correct dependency order — parallelising where it safely can.

3. TESTING: Two test types exist. (a) Generic tests — built-in assertions like not_null, unique, accepted_values, and relationships — declared in a YAML file alongside each model. (b) Singular tests — custom SQL files that return rows only when a test fails. Tests run via 'dbt test'.

4. SOURCES & STAGING LAYER: Raw tables in the warehouse are declared as 'sources' in YAML. A thin 'staging' model layer renames, casts, and cleans each source table exactly once, giving every downstream model a single clean starting point.

5. MACROS & JINJA: dbt uses Jinja templating inside SQL, enabling reusable logic (macros), environment-aware logic (dev vs. prod schemas), and dynamic SQL generation — without needing a Python script.

6. DOCUMENTATION & LINEAGE: 'dbt docs generate' creates a static website showing every model's description, column definitions, test results, and an interactive DAG lineage graph. This is auto-updated on every run.

7. SEEDS & SNAPSHOTS: Seeds load small static CSV files (e.g. country code lookups) into the warehouse as tables. Snapshots implement Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD Type 2) logic — capturing row-level history as source records change over time.
data_science.when_to_use: Use dbt when: (1) Your team writes SQL transforms scattered across stored procedures, one-off scripts, or BI tool calculated fields — dbt consolidates and versions all of it. (2) You need auditable, tested data pipelines — every column assertion is codified and runs on a schedule. (3) You want non-engineers (analysts) to contribute to the data pipeline safely via Pull Requests rather than touching production directly. (4) You are building a semantic/metrics layer — dbt's Metrics API lets you define company-wide KPI definitions (e.g. 'ARR', 'churn rate') once, so every downstream tool queries the same number. (5) You need full lineage for regulatory or data governance reasons — the DAG graph shows exactly which raw source feeds which dashboard. Avoid dbt for heavy Python-native transforms (use Spark/pandas for ML feature engineering), real-time streaming (dbt is batch-oriented), or when your data volume makes in-warehouse compute prohibitively expensive.
data_science.worked_example:
D&B Data Products — Temporal Entity Resolution Pipeline

Scenario: D&B ingests raw firmographic feeds daily from dozens of third-party data vendors. Before any Paydex score, Buydex signal, or corporate family tree can be trusted by an AI agent, the underlying business entity records must be cleaned, standardised, and resolved to a canonical DUNS number. Today this involves brittle stored procedures. Here is how dbt restructures it:

STAGING LAYER (stg_vendor_records.sql):
Each vendor feed gets its own staging model. The model casts raw strings to correct types, standardises country codes to ISO 3166, strips whitespace from business names, and renames columns to D&B's internal schema — all in a single SELECT. A not_null test on 'raw_duns_candidate' and a unique test on 'vendor_record_id' run nightly.

INTERMEDIATE LAYER (int_entity_candidates.sql):
A model joins staged vendor records to D&B's internal DUNS master table using blocking keys (country + postal code + name token). It outputs a candidate-match table — one row per (vendor_record, duns_candidate) pair — with a similarity score pre-computed via a dbt macro wrapping a warehouse-native fuzzy-match function.

MARTS LAYER (mart_resolved_entities.sql):
Applies a threshold rule (score ≥ 0.85 → resolved; < 0.85 → queued for human review). Materialised as a table refreshed daily. An accepted_values test asserts resolution_status is always one of ['resolved', 'pending_review', 'unresolvable'].

SNAPSHOT (snap_duns_master.sql):
A dbt snapshot captures SCD Type 2 history on the DUNS master table — so when a company's legal name or corporate parent changes, the old row is closed with a valid_to timestamp and a new row opens. This is the temporal audit trail that makes D&B's Ground Truth explainability story credible: an AI agent can always ask 'what did we know about this entity on date X?' and get a deterministic answer.

METRICS LAYER:
A dbt metric named 'entity_resolution_rate' is defined as resolved_count / total_candidate_count, scoped by vendor and date. Every BI tool — Tableau, Looker, the internal AI agent dashboard — queries this single definition, eliminating the 'which number is right?' argument in sales reviews.

BUSINESS IMPACT: The entire pipeline is version-controlled in Git. A new vendor onboards by adding one staging model and one YAML test file — no stored procedure changes, no DBA ticket. The lineage graph in dbt docs shows exactly which raw vendor feed flows into which Paydex input feature, satisfying both internal audit and enterprise customer due-diligence requests.
resources: dbt Official Documentation — getdbt.com/docs: covers all core concepts (models, tests, snapshots, macros, metrics) with warehouse-specific guides for Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, and Redshift

'The Analytics Engineering Guide' by dbt Labs — a free, structured curriculum explaining the ELT philosophy, staging/intermediate/mart layering pattern, and how analytics engineering differs from traditional data engineering
'Fundamentals of Analytics Engineering' course on dbt Learn (learn.getdbt.com) — free, self-paced, hands-on labs building a real dbt project from raw source tables to tested, documented marts
